summary: ArcBot now launches from a writable user folder, discovers available Codex models, and defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol.
details: Builds require Codex CLI 0.146.0 or newer with GPT-5.6 Sol in its bundled catalog, then validate the complete Node, npm, and Codex runtime before packaging and again in the unpacked application.
The Repair action installs Codex into an ArcRho-owned per-user npm prefix without requiring a machine-global Node installation.

Saved legacy model selections remain available when supported, reasoning choices follow each discovered model's capabilities, and stale catalogs prompt Repair instead of exposing an unadvertised model.
